name: oecd-mcp-server
description: Search and query 1,500+ OECD statistical datasets via SDMX. Keyless.

OECD_DATAFRAME_DROP_ENABLED.title: Enable oecd_dataframe_drop
OECD_DATAFRAME_DROP_ENABLED.description: Let callers drop staged DataCanvas tables with oecd_dataframe_drop. Registered but disabled when off.

OECD_CLAMP_LIMITS.title: Serve an over-the-cap limit at the cap
OECD_CLAMP_LIMITS.description: Serve a limit above a tool's per-call cap at the cap, with a notice. When off, such a limit is rejected and the cap is advertised as its maximum.
